paper: Cengiz, Dube, Lindner, Zipperer (2019), 'The Effect of Minimum Wages on Low-Wage Jobs', QJE 134(3).

environment.stata_note: Stata is commercial software requiring a paid license; no binary/license present and it cannot be installed without one. Ported the analysis faithfully to R.
environment.gpu_model: 4x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (not needed; econometrics is CPU-bound)

port_methodology.reghdfe_to_fixest: absorb(i.wagebinstate i.wagequarterdate ...) -> fixest FE part; varying slopes i.fe##c.x -> fe[x]; interaction i.a##i.b -> a^b; bare categorical controls (postcont*, controlf) -> factor() FE; i.one#c.var linear controls (window, before/after treats) -> ordinary RHS regressors (FWL-equivalent for the reported treat coefficients).
port_methodology.lincom: linear combo w'beta with clustered VCE: se=sqrt(w'Vw).
port_methodology.weights: Stata aweight -> fixest weights (scale-invariant for point est & clustered VCE).
port_methodology.treatment_design: All treat_*/window_*/control_* dummies were pre-computed columns in state_panels_with3quant1979.dta (treatmentdefinition primary branch only loads data), so no reconstruction needed.
port_methodology.scalars: E (affected E/pop), B (below share b-bar), EWB (below wage-bill share), wagemult, mwpc reproduced from weighted subsample means with Stata missing-value comparison semantics (missing behaves as +Inf).
